title: PHYSICS-INFORMED NEURAL NETWORKS FOR ELASTIC PLATE PROBLEMS WITH BENDING AND WINKLER-TYPE CONTACT EFFECTS
venue: Journal of the Serbian Society for Computational Mechanics

corresponding_authors.name: Aliki D. Muradova
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Computational Mechanics and Optimization, School of Production Engineering and Management, Technical University of Crete, Chania, Greece

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用PINN求解弹性板弯曲和Winkler接触问题，方法可迁移至生物力学中的接触力学和结构优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 用PINN求解弹性板弯曲和Winkler接触问题，避免传统数值方法的网格依赖。
summary_zh.method: 构建基于力学定律的PINN，使用Adam和L-BFGS优化损失函数。
summary_zh.result: PINN能准确预测不同地基常数下的板挠度和接触压力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验比较不同网络结构和采样点下的计算误差。

summary_en.motivation: To solve Kirchhoff plate bending and Winkler-type contact problems using physics-informed neural networks, avoiding mesh generation and discretization errors.
summary_en.method: A PINN is constructed by embedding the governing PDEs and boundary conditions into the loss function, optimized with Adam and L-BFGS algorithms.
summary_en.result: The PINN accurately predicts plate deflections and contact pressures for various foundation stiffness values, with error decreasing as network complexity increases.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks with analytical or reference solutions are used to evaluate the effect of epochs, hidden layers, neurons, and collocation points.

E-SINDy exploits the statistical method of bootstrap aggregating (bagging) to identify ordinary and partial differential equations that govern the dynamics of observed noisy data. First, sparse regression is performed on bootstraps of the measured data, or on the library terms in case of library bagging, to identify an ensemble of SINDy models. The mean or median of the coefficients are then computed, coefficients with low inclusion probabilities are thresholded, and the E-SINDy model is aggregated and used for forecasting. summary_zh.motivation: 核事故分析中需高效识别高风险输入配置，但高保真仿真计算昂贵。
summary_zh.method: 提出ICSCREAM方法，先用HSIC全局敏感性分析筛选重要输入，再序贯构建高斯过程元模型估计条件超越概率。
summary_zh.result: 在约100个输入、1000次仿真的条件下，成功识别了压水堆失水事故中峰值包壳温度的关键输入区域。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个热工水力工业案例验证，对比了筛选与元模型的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient identification of penalizing input configurations under uncertainty is critical for risk assessment in nuclear accident analysis, but high-fidelity simulations are computationally prohibitive.
summary_en.method: The ICSCREAM methodology combines Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion screening to select influential inputs with a sequentially built Gaussian process metamodel to estimate conditional probabilities of exceeding a high threshold.
summary_en.result: Applied to two high-dimensional thermal-hydraulic cases with about 100 inputs, the method identified critical scenario input regions for peak cladding temperature using only around 1000 code simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed on two industrial loss-of-coolant accident simulations, demonstrating the methodology's efficiency in estimating conditional probabilities and identifying critical configurations.

summary_en.result: The method achieves superior performance and generalizability across multiple test cases with limited labeled data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through several simulation cases comparing predicted temperature histories with FE simulation results.

summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms existing approaches on synthetic and real-world optimization problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and real-world problem experiments.

summary_en.result: RAHBO effectively identifies solutions with high return and low noise variance on synthetic benchmarks and hyperparameter tuning tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and hyperparameter tuning experiments.

summary_zh.method: 提出基于信息论的主动任务选择机制

summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the number of costly labeling steps required for meta-learning in black-box optimization.
summary_en.method: An information-theoretic active task selection mechanism is introduced for Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: The approach improves data efficiency in optimizing black-box models.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic and wireless system optimization tasks.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on vehicle body dynamics, not biomedical implant design or biomechanics, and lacks uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高柔性车身有限元模型更新的效率和精度
summary_zh.method: 基于实测频响函数，构建Kriging代理模型进行多目标优化

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of finite element model updating for flexible vehicle bodies using experimental frequency response data.

summary_en.result: The updated model shows good agreement with experimental FRFs, and the rigid-flexible MBS model predicts vibration and ride comfort more accurately.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing simulated FRFs with experimental ones and by evaluating dynamic performance in a rigid-flexible MBS model against test results.

title: Efficient Exploration in Binary and Preferential Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化方法可处理昂贵黑箱函数，并区分认知不确定性与偶然不确定性，对植入物设计中的多目标优化和不确定性量化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on binary and preferential BO for general black-box optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 在仅有二元或偏好反馈的昂贵优化中，高效探索需要区分不确定性类型。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于认知不确定性的新采集函数，并推广到批量学习。
summary_zh.result: 新采集函数在二元和偏好贝叶斯优化中优于现有启发式方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上测试，与多种基线方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient exploration in Bayesian optimization with binary or preferential feedback requires distinguishing epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Novel acquisition functions that leverage epistemic uncertainty are proposed and extended to batch learning.
summary_en.result: The proposed acquisition functions outperform state-of-the-art heuristics on binary and preferential BO benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks with comparisons to multiple baselines.

title: Constrained Discrete Black-Box Optimization using Mixed-Integer Programming
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的NN+MILP框架可用于解决离散设计空间中的约束优化问题，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; it focuses on discrete black-box optimization with MILP-based acquisition optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 离散黑箱优化中组合约束难以处理，现有启发式方法近似且不灵活。
summary_zh.method: 使用分段线性神经网络作为代理模型，混合整数线性规划优化采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上超越或匹配专用算法，求解时间仅需几分钟。
summary_zh.validation: 在DNA结合、MINLPLib和NAS-Bench-101基准上测试。

summary_en.motivation: Discrete black-box optimization with combinatorial constraints is challenging for model-based methods due to the need for repeated complex global optimization.
summary_en.method: A framework using piecewise-linear neural networks as surrogates and mixed-integer linear programming to optimize the acquisition function with optimality guarantees.
summary_en.result: The proposed method matches or surpasses constraint-tailored black-box algorithms on several benchmarks with practical runtime.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on DNA binding, constrained binary quadratic problems from MINLPLib, and NAS-Bench-101 neural architecture search.

title: A portfolio approach to massively parallel Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的大规模并行贝叶斯优化方法可加速昂贵黑箱优化，对植入物设计中的多目标优化和不确定性量化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on general black-box optimization with synthetic noisy functions.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速昂贵黑箱函数的并行优化，应对大规模并行评估需求
summary_zh.method: 提出基于投资组合分配策略的批量贝叶斯优化方法，平衡探索与利用
summary_zh.result: 在噪声函数上实现数量级速度提升，性能相当或更优
summary_zh.validation: 在合成噪声函数上进行单目标和多目标优化基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To reduce optimization time for expensive black-box functions by enabling massive parallel evaluations beyond traditional batch Bayesian optimization limits.
summary_en.method: Proposes a scalable batch Bayesian optimization strategy using a portfolio allocation approach to manage exploration-exploitation trade-off and handle noisy evaluations.
summary_en.result: Achieves orders of magnitude speedup over existing methods on noisy synthetic functions for both single- and multi-objective tasks with comparable or better performance.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic noisy benchmark functions for single- and multi-objective optimization, comparing against related batch BO methods.

why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond point prediction, or implant/biomechanics design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 动态环境下昂贵黑箱优化问题难以求解，现有贝叶斯优化方法多针对静态环境。
summary_zh.method: 通过增强协方差函数利用历史观测与当前观测的关系，实现贝叶斯优化在动态环境中的迁移。
summary_zh.result: 在合成基准和实际案例中验证了算法在有限预算下的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准函数和实际案例上进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Expensive black-box optimization in dynamic environments is challenging, and Bayesian optimization has rarely been studied for such settings.
summary_en.method: The proposed method augments the covariance function with a measure of relationship between historical and current observations to enable transfer learning in Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and a real-world case study demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm under a limited computational budget.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic benchmark functions and a real-world case study.

title: Simulation Failure Robust Bayesian Optimization for Estimating Black-Box Model Parameters

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant biomechanics; it focuses on parameter calibration with simulation failures.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真仿真模型参数校准时，部分参数组合导致仿真失败，需避免此类区域。
summary_zh.method: 提出失败鲁棒贝叶斯优化算法，从仿真数据中学习失败区域并指导优化避开。

summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准问题上验证算法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity simulations often fail for certain parameter combinations, hindering calibration; this work aims to learn and avoid failure regions during optimization.
summary_en.method: A failure-robust Bayesian optimization (FR-BO) algorithm that models failure probability from simulation data and incorporates it into the acquisition function to avoid high-failure regions.
summary_en.result: FR-BO accelerates convergence and reduces wasted simulations compared to standard Bayesian optimization on benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic numerical benchmarks with simulated failure regions.

title: Multi-Pronged Safe Bayesian Optimization for High Dimensions

corresponding_authors.name: Stefano De Blasi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Bosch Rexroth AG,Lohr am Main,Germany,97816

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高维安全贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维安全优化计算成本高，现有方法探索与利用不平衡。
summary_zh.method: 提出多管齐下的安全贝叶斯优化，迭代定义椭圆和线性子空间分别用于探索和利用。
summary_zh.result: 在40维测试函数上优于所有对比方法，并成功应用于电力系统。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试和电力系统案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Safe Bayesian optimization suffers from high computational cost in high dimensions, and existing decomposition strategies fail to balance exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.method: A multi-pronged safe Bayesian optimization approach is proposed that iteratively defines ellipsoidal and linear sub-spaces for exploration and exploitation, respectively, with shapes adapted via Gaussian process regression.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms all evaluated safe optimization methods on up to 40-dimensional test functions and is applied to a complex power grid system.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on synthetic test functions and a case study on a power grid system.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种嵌套加权切比雪夫多目标贝叶斯优化方法，可处理昂贵黑箱问题中的约束和不确定性，其模型选择策略和优化框架可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的多目标优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, lacks experimental validation, and does not address contact mechanics or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有加权切比雪夫多目标贝叶斯优化缺乏回归模型选择灵活性，导致过拟合或欠拟合。
summary_zh.method: 提出嵌套框架，从模型池中基于RMSE选择最佳回归模型，结合加权切比雪夫采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在多模态基准和薄管设计中，相比其他MOBO框架，参数估计和Pareto前沿精度更高，评估成本更低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准和薄管设计案例验证，与多种MOBO框架对比性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing weighted Tchebycheff multi-objective Bayesian optimization lacks flexibility in regression model selection, leading to underfitting or overfitting as iterations progress.
summary_en.method: A nested framework is proposed that selects the best regression model from an ensemble based on RMSE, integrated with a weighted Tchebycheff acquisition function.
summary_en.result: On a multimodal benchmark and a thin tube design problem, the proposed method achieves better parameter estimation and Pareto front accuracy with lower function evaluation cost compared to other MOBO frameworks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a numerical benchmark and a thin tube design case, with comparisons against multiple MOBO frameworks.

summary_en.motivation: Scaling Bayesian optimization to high-dimensional black-box functions remains challenging due to exponential growth in model hyperparameter estimation complexity.
summary_en.method: BOFiP decomposes the high-dimensional space into low-dimensional subspaces via random partitions and alternates Bayesian optimization within subspaces with information exchange using fictitious play from game theory.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on benchmark functions from 20 to 1000 dimensions and on neural network architecture design problems with up to 10,000 weights.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic benchmarks and a neural network architecture design problem demonstrate consistent performance gains across increasing dimensionality.

summary_en.motivation: The high computational cost of repeatedly calling the performance function in evidence-theory-based reliability analysis hinders its practical engineering application.
summary_en.method: An active learning Kriging surrogate model is constructed using intersection points and Latin hypercube sampling to approximate the performance function efficiently.
summary_en.result: Belief and plausibility measures are derived with significantly reduced computational cost while maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on three numerical examples and a reliability analysis of an industrial robot's positioning accuracy.

summary_en.result: The crushable foam model accurately reproduced the post-yield stress-strain response under uniaxial loading and confined compression up to 15% strain.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on convection, reaction, and diffusion equations.

summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing with exact solutions on numerical benchmark problems.

summary_zh.method: 提出灰盒建模框架，用双贝叶斯滤波估计残差力，再用高斯过程学习映射并修正方程。

summary_en.motivation: To improve predictive capability of approximate governing equations for nonlinear dynamical systems by identifying and compensating unknown model-form errors.
summary_en.method: A gray-box modeling framework that estimates residual forces via dual Bayesian filter joint input-state estimation and learns a mapping from estimated states to model-form error using Gaussian process regression.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately estimates system states and generalizes to unseen environments across four different nonlinear dynamical systems.
summary_en.validation: Validation via simulation case studies on four distinct nonlinear dynamical systems demonstrating reliability and applicability.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发TPMS结构渗透性的解析预测模型，以优化骨替代材料的流体性能。
summary_zh.method: 生成三种TPMS结构（Fisher-Koch S、Gyroid、Schwarz P）的CAD模型，用CFD计算渗透率并拟合几何参数依赖的解析模型。
summary_zh.result: 渗透率随孔隙率增加而增加，解析模型预测误差小于5%。
summary_zh.validation: CFD数值模拟验证，R²>0.99。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an analytical model for predicting permeability of TPMS structures based on geometric parameters, enabling optimization of fluid flow in bone scaffolds.
summary_en.method: CAD models of three TPMS architectures (Fisher-Koch S, Gyroid, Schwarz P) with varying cell size and porosity were generated; permeability was computed via CFD and used to fit a geometry-dependent analytical model.
summary_en.result: Permeability increased with porosity at different rates for each architecture, and the analytical model predicted permeability with a difference <5% (R²>0.99).
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through CFD simulations, showing excellent fit to the analytical model.

summary_en.validation: Experimental validation included mechanical testing (compression and tension) and microstructural analysis via SEM and XCT.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索混合TPMS点阵结构能否比单一结构具有更优的力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过隐式函数设计Gyroid和Diamond的线性和径向混合点阵，采用LS-DYNA有限元模拟和实验验证。
summary_zh.result: 混合点阵的力学性能可通过成分比例调控，实验与模拟结果吻合良好。
summary_zh.validation: 对三种相对密度的单一结构进行动态和准静态实验验证，再预测混合结构并实验确认。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether hybrid TPMS cellular lattices can achieve superior mechanical properties compared to uniform lattices.
summary_en.method: Hybrid lattices (Gyroid and Diamond) were designed using implicit functions in linear and radial configurations, and their mechanical behavior was predicted via validated LS-DYNA finite element models and confirmed by LPBF fabrication and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The hybrid lattices exhibited tunable mechanical properties that agreed well between simulation and experiment, demonstrating potential for crashworthiness applications.
summary_en.validation: Finite element models were validated against experimental data for three relative densities of constituent lattices under dynamic and quasi-static loading, then applied to predict hybrid lattice behavior, which was subsequently verified experimentally.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效传播固体动力学中材料属性的全场不确定性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently propagate material property uncertainty to full-field quantities of interest in solid dynamics without a priori knowledge of failure points.
summary_en.method: A minimally invasive method that computes a small subset of ensemble exactly and approximates the remainder using evolution equations based on exact solutions, exploiting parameter dependence and smoothness.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated accuracy, efficiency, scaling with parameter dimension, and convergence in distribution on a quasi-1D bar impact and a 2D notched plate impact problem.
summary_en.validation: Validated against an analytical PDF solution for the bar impact problem and through parallel efficiency scaling for the notched plate problem.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties in flame impulse response estimation from LES/SI, which is computationally prohibitive with traditional Monte Carlo methods.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently handle loading uncertainties in topology optimization while avoiding the high computational cost of Monte Carlo simulation.

summary_en.result: The SROM approach achieves substantial efficiency gains over Monte Carlo while maintaining comparable accuracy, and can handle discrete/continuous and correlated random inputs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks with various uncertainty distributions demonstrate the flexibility, efficiency, and accuracy of the proposed method.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统数值方法求解对流-扩散方程在高Péclet数下精度不足。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a discretization-free method for solving advection-dispersion equations that remains accurate at high Péclet numbers.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network simultaneously approximates hydraulic head, concentration, and hydraulic conductivity fields by minimizing PDE residuals and boundary/initial conditions.
summary_en.result: The PINN achieves less than 1% error for forward problems and under 5% for backward problems, with measurement incorporation improving accuracy by over 50%.
summary_en.validation: Compared against analytical and numerical solutions for 1D and 2D cases across various Péclet numbers.

summary_en.motivation: To identify material parameters in a phase-field damage model using pseudo-experimental data via an inverse problem approach.

summary_en.result: The PINN method shows better robustness to noise than PDE-constrained optimization and provides accurate parameter estimates.
summary_en.validation: Tested on a simple physical case with pseudo-experimental data and noise analysis.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate rare event probabilities while minimizing the number of expensive high-fidelity simulations.

summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验和有限元模拟验证晶格结构力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce weight and minimize stress shielding in a shoulder hemi-prosthesis by integrating lattice structures.
summary_en.method: Three lattice configurations (TVC, HPVC, CD) were fabricated in resin and tested mechanically; the best (HPVC) was incorporated into a digital twin and simulated with Ti6Al4V material properties.
summary_en.result: The HPVC lattice yielded maximum von Mises stress of 325 MPa, below the yield limit of titanium alloys, and 52 MPa in an equivalent elastic model, comparable to bone.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression testing of resin lattices and finite element simulations of the titanium prosthesis.

summary_en.method: A finite element model of the human torso was built from patient imaging, with beam elements for leads and a friction-based tissue interaction; all inputs were treated as uncertain intervals for optimization-based uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The new lead design with reduced axial stiffness resulted in smaller tip displacement, indicating improved stability near the therapeutic target.
summary_en.validation: Model predictions were validated against cadaver experiments where lead tip displacement was measured via CT imaging.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of build orientation on the microstructure and properties of a biodegradable high manganese steel processed by laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Samples of Fe-30Mn-1C-0.02S alloy were fabricated by LPBF with different build orientations and characterized by EBSD, tensile/compression tests, and potentiodynamic polarization.
summary_en.result: Build orientation significantly influenced yield strength, Young's modulus, and corrosion behavior, with perpendicular orientation yielding higher strength due to defect orientation.
summary_en.validation: Quasi-static tensile and compression tests, and potentiodynamic polarization in simulated body fluid.

title: A Nonmyopic Approach to Cost-Constrained Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法处理代价昂贵黑箱函数优化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型优化场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, does not include biomechanical or implant design context, and the constraint handling is limited to cost constraints rather than physical design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 实际优化中不同区域评估成本不同，标准BO未考虑成本差异。
summary_zh.method: 将成本约束BO建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并推导高效 rollout 近似策略。
summary_zh.result: 在超参数优化和传感器选择问题上验证了成本效率优势。
summary_zh.validation: 在超参数优化与传感器选择基准问题上的数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: In many optimization tasks, the evaluation cost varies across the search space, rendering standard Bayesian optimization inefficient under cost constraints.
summary_en.method: The paper formulates cost-constrained Bayesian optimization as a constrained Markov decision process and develops an efficient rollout approximation to the optimal policy.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves superior cost efficiency on hyperparameter optimization and sensor set selection benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on hyperparameter optimization and sensor set selection problems demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

summary_en.motivation: To combine scientific computing and machine learning to develop explainable, data-efficient hybrid models that leverage physical laws.
summary_en.method: Proposes model-constrained machine learning (mcML) approaches including ROM-ML, model-constrained deep neural networks, and model-constrained autoencoders.
summary_en.result: Theoretical and numerical results demonstrate validity for various PDE-constrained inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on PDE-constrained inverse problems.

summary_zh.method: 采用响应面法构建替代模型，通过ABAQUS参数化研究筛选输入参数并建立响应面。

summary_zh.validation: 用未参与建模的ABAQUS案例验证替代模型精度。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of finite element analysis in dynamic site response and enable uncertainty propagation of input parameters.
summary_en.method: A response surface surrogate model is constructed from ABAQUS parametric studies, with input parameter screening and sampling for reliability-based formulation.
summary_en.result: The surrogate accurately predicts the mean and standard deviation of peak ground acceleration, facilitating probabilistic seismic risk analysis.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing surrogate predictions with ABAQUS results on unseen cases.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how porosity affects the mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V parts made by high-power selective laser melting for potential biomedical applications.

title: Targeted Active Learning for Bayesian Decision-Making
relevance_to_user: 该方法将主动学习与贝叶斯决策相结合，可迁移到基于代理模型的植入物设计优化中，提高决策准确性。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling in FEA, does not handle constraints explicitly, and does not validate on surrogate modeling or biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统主动学习仅优化预测精度，忽略了后续决策任务的实际需求。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种最大化最优决策后验期望信息增益的主动学习策略。
summary_zh.result: 在模拟和真实数据上，该策略显著提高了决策准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟数据和真实数据实验验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard active learning maximizes prediction accuracy but is sub-optimal when the ultimate goal is decision-making under uncertainty.
summary_en.method: This work introduces a targeted active learning criterion that acquires labels to maximize the expected information gain on the posterior distribution of the optimal decision.
summary_en.result: The proposed strategy outperforms existing active learning methods in decision-making accuracy on both simulated and real datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical experiments on simulated data and real-world datasets, demonstrating improved decision outcomes.

title: Reinforced Few-Shot Acquisition Function Learning for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过强化学习优化贝叶斯优化的采集函数，可迁移至生物力学设计中代理模型的采样策略。
why_not_core: Does not address surrogate modeling for FEA, lacks biomechanics context, and does not handle constraints or uncertainty quantification in implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统采集函数在不同黑箱函数上表现不稳定，需通用自适应采集函数。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于贝叶斯深度Q网络和少样本学习的采集函数学习方法FSAF。
summary_zh.result: 在多种合成和真实函数上取得与前沿方法相当或更优的累积遗憾。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数和真实世界测试函数上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Handcrafted acquisition functions in Bayesian optimization perform inconsistently across different black-box functions, necessitating a versatile adaptive approach.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Bayesian deep Q-network with few-shot learning, incorporating KL regularization and meta-learning for robust acquisition function learning.
summary_en.result: Achieves comparable or better regret than state-of-the-art methods on a variety of synthetic and real-world test functions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmarks and real-world test functions, showing improved sample efficiency.

title: Learning Functional Priors and Posteriors from Data and Physics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于物理生成对抗网络和哈密顿蒙特卡洛的贝叶斯框架具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not directly address FEA surrogate modelling for implant biomechanics, nor does it handle constraints in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用历史数据和物理信息学习函数先验并量化不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 采用PI-GAN学习先验，HMC在后验空间采样，结合PINNs或DeepONet编码物理。
summary_zh.result: 在少量含噪数据下提供准确预测和不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维回归、PDE正反问题、分数阶扩散及随机流等数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a Bayesian framework that leverages historical data and physics to learn functional priors and quantify uncertainties in physical problems with noisy and gappy observations.
summary_en.method: The method uses physics-informed generative adversarial networks (PI-GAN) to learn functional priors and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) for posterior estimation, encoding physics via automatic differentiation (PINNs) or operator regression (DeepONet).
summary_en.result: The approach yields accurate predictions and uncertainty quantification from limited, scattered, and noisy data, demonstrated on 1D regression, forward/inverse PDE problems, fractional diffusion, and spatial-temporal inference.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and a simulated spatial-temporal regression case for marine riser displacement, without experimental or clinical data.

summary_en.motivation: Optimizing expensive black-box functions with both discrete and continuous inputs is challenging yet prevalent in real-world applications.
summary_en.method: The authors propose Hybrid Bayesian Optimization (HyBO) using diffusion kernels over hybrid spaces via additive kernel formulation, which captures all-order interactions tractably.
summary_en.result: HyBO significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and six diverse real-world benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on synthetic functions and real-world optimization benchmarks (e.g., materials design, hyperparameter tuning).

summary_zh.method: 提出一种新的PINN训练方法，增强时间外推能力。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在多个基准问题上误差降低高达72%。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准问题（如Burgers方程）上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs perform poorly on temporal extrapolation tasks, motivating a novel training approach.
summary_en.method: A new training method for PINNs is proposed to improve extrapolation accuracy in time-dependent PDEs.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves up to 72% lower L2 error compared to state-of-the-art methods on benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks including Burgers' equation and other nonlinear PDEs.

title: Conformal Prediction using Conditional Histograms
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了适用于回归的不确定性量化技术，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的变异性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply to FEA surrogate modeling, handle constraints in optimization, or address biomechanics/implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 为偏斜数据提供自适应预测区间
summary_zh.method: 利用黑箱机器学习估计条件分布直方图
summary_zh.result: 渐进实现条件覆盖率和最优长度
summary_zh.validation: 模拟与真实数据实验对比

summary_en.motivation: To construct prediction intervals that automatically adapt to skewed data in non-parametric regression.
summary_en.method: Leverages black-box ML algorithms to estimate conditional distribution via histograms and outputs shortest prediction intervals.
summary_en.result: Achieves marginal coverage in finite samples and asymptotically attains conditional coverage and optimal length.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on simulated and real datasets demonstrate improved performance over existing methods.

title: Ultrasonic fatigue testing in as-built and polished Ti6Al4V alloy manufactured by SLM

corresponding_authors.name: M. Freitas
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Atlântica, Instituto Universitário, Fabrica da Pólvora, Barcarena 2730-036, Portugal

relevance_to_user: 该论文评估了SLM Ti6Al4V合金的表面粗糙度对超高周疲劳强度的影响，但对骨植入物的应力屏蔽和多孔结构设计未涉及。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous lattice structures for stress shielding reduction nor bone-implant stiffness matching; it focuses on fatigue of fully dense specimens.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估SLM Ti6Al4V表面粗糙度和缺陷对超高周疲劳寿命的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过超声疲劳测试对比未抛光与抛光试样的疲劳性能
summary_zh.result: 抛光试样疲劳强度显著提高，裂纹从表面启动转为次表面启动
summary_zh.validation: 机械疲劳实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Evaluate the influence of surface roughness and defects on very high cycle fatigue life of SLM Ti6Al4V.
summary_en.method: Ultrasonic fatigue testing (UFT) was conducted on as-built and polished specimens under R=-1.
summary_en.result: Polished specimens exhibited significantly higher fatigue strength and a shift from surface to subsurface crack initiation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental ultrasonic fatigue tests with fractographic analysis.

title: The impact of surface treatment in 3-dimensional printed implants for early osseointegration: a comparison study of three different surfaces.
first_author_affiliation: One-Stop Specialty Center, Seoul National University Dental Hospital, Seoul, Republic of Korea.; Department of Periodontology and Dental Research Institute, School of Dentistry, Seoul National University, 101, Daehak-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul, 03080, Korea.

corresponding_authors.name: Ki-Tae Koo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Periodontology and Dental Research Institute, School of Dentistry, Seoul National University, 101, Daehak-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul, 03080, Korea. periokoo@snu.ac.kr.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及的表面处理技术可能对AM生物医学植入物的骨整合研究有借鉴意义，但未涉及应力遮挡或力学测试。
why_not_core: No stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and no link to hip implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同表面处理对3D打印植入物早期骨整合的影响
summary_zh.method: 使用DMLS制备钛种植体，分别进行未处理、SLA和TIPS表面处理，植入兔胫骨进行组织形态学分析
summary_zh.result: TIPS处理组在早期（2周）显示出更高的骨-种植体接触和骨面积占比
summary_zh.validation: 兔胫骨植入模型组织学验证

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of different surface treatments on early osseointegration of 3D-printed dental implants.
summary_en.method: DMLS-fabricated titanium implants with three surface treatments (none, SLA, TIPS) were implanted in rabbit tibiae and analyzed histomorphometrically.
summary_en.result: TIPS-treated implants exhibited significantly higher bone-to-implant contact and bone area fraction at 2 weeks, indicating enhanced early osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rabbit tibia model with histological and histomorphometric analysis.

key_terms.zh: 靶离子诱导等离子溅射

title: Physics-informed attention-based neural network for solving non-linear partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的注意力机制物理信息神经网络可能迁移用于生物力学中偏微分方程的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on direct PDE solving with attention mechanisms, but does not address sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准物理信息神经网络难以求解含激波的非线性双曲型偏微分方程。
summary_zh.method: 提出结合循环神经网络和注意力机制的PIANN架构，自动适应解的非线性特征。
summary_zh.result: PIANN有效捕捉激波前沿，并在训练集内外均提供高质量解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维双曲型守恒律数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard physics-informed neural networks struggle to solve nonlinear hyperbolic PDEs with sharp shock fronts.
summary_en.method: A novel architecture, PIANN, combines recurrent neural networks with attention mechanisms to adapt to nonlinear solution features.
summary_en.result: PIANN accurately captures shock fronts and produces high-quality solutions both inside and beyond the training set.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical benchmark of one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws.

title: Parallel Bayesian Optimization of Multiple Noisy Objectives with Expected Hypervolume Improvement
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理多目标贝叶斯优化中噪声观测的方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的多目标优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints, is not applied to implant/biomechanics design, and has no validation in biomedical or structural mechanics contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 多目标优化中观测噪声导致Pareto前沿估计不准确
summary_zh.method: 提出NEHVI采集函数，对EHVI进行贝叶斯处理并扩展至并行批量优化qNEHVI
summary_zh.result: qNEHVI显著提升鲁棒性，在大批量环境下达到最优性能
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和标准基准问题上进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of noisy observations in multi-objective Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Introduces NEHVI, a Bayesian treatment of expected hypervolume improvement, and its parallel variant qNEHVI with polynomial complexity.
summary_en.result: qNEHVI achieves state-of-the-art optimization performance and is robust to observation noise.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated on synthetic and standard benchmark problems.

title: Numerical evaluation of high cycle fatigue life for additively manufactured stainless steel 316L lattice structures: Preliminary considerations
first_author_affiliation: Department of Civil Engineering and Architecture University of Pavia  Pavia Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Massimo Carraturo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Civil Engineering and Architecture University of Pavia  Pavia Italy

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了增材制造点阵结构的高周疲劳寿命数值评估方法，但未涉及生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration; it focuses on fatigue life prediction of lattice structures using as-built geometry, but lacks experimental validation and biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 增材制造点阵结构因工艺缺陷导致疲劳性能难以预测，需考虑实际几何。
summary_zh.method: 采用浸入边界法（有限胞元法）基于微CT扫描的成型几何直接计算疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.result: 数值框架可有效评估成型点阵结构的高周疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 仅数值模拟，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Process-induced geometrical defects in additively manufactured lattice structures significantly affect fatigue behavior, necessitating numerical methods that incorporate as-built geometry.
summary_en.method: An immersed boundary method (finite cell method) is employed to compute fatigue life directly on as-built lattice geometry acquired via micro-CT.
summary_en.result: The proposed numerical framework enables fatigue life prediction for as-built lattice structures, accounting for geometric imperfections.
summary_en.validation: The study is purely numerical with no experimental validation; it demonstrates the framework on a representative lattice geometry.

title: Migration characteristics of the Corail hydroxyapatite-coated femoral stem—a retrospective clinical evaluation and migration measurement with EBRA
venue: Archives of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology, Medical University of Innsbruck, Anichstrasse 35, 6020, Innsbruck, Austria

corresponding_authors.name: Dietmar Dammerer
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology, Medical University of Innsbruck, Anichstrasse 35, 6020, Innsbruck, Austria

relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了Corail股骨柄的临床迁移数据，但未涉及有限元建模或应力遮挡分析。
why_not_core: This paper is a clinical retrospective study with EBRA migration measurements, but it does not include any finite element analysis, stress shielding quantification, or contact mechanics modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Corail羟基磷灰石涂层股骨柄的迁移行为及预测长期效果。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析109例患者，使用EBRA-FCA软件测量股骨柄下沉。
summary_zh.result: 带颈领柄平均下沉1.3mm，显著低于无颈领柄的3.2mm。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访2年，EBRA放射学测量验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the migration behavior of the Corail hydroxyapatite-coated femoral stem and identify risk factors for early implant failure.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study of 109 stems in 105 patients was conducted, with migration measured using EBRA-FCA software on radiographs.
summary_en.result: Collared stems showed significantly lower mean subsidence (1.3 mm) compared to collarless stems (3.2 mm) at 18 months.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation with two-year follow-up and EBRA radiographic analysis.

title: A surrogate model for studying random field energy release rates in 2D brittle fractures
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于脆性断裂的代理模型，通过降阶计算90%时间，并包含不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: The paper addresses brittle fracture mechanics, not implant biomechanics, lacks contact mechanics or bone-implant interface modeling, and does not consider patient-specific geometry or material properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低脆性断裂模拟的计算成本，实现随机场能量释放率的蒙特卡洛研究。
summary_zh.method: 提出加权变分模型作为相位场断裂模型的代理，采用高斯随机场模拟非均匀能量释放率。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型减少90%执行时间，且能准确预测断裂分布和载荷-位移曲线。
summary_zh.validation: 通过与实验室脆性断裂实验对比验证代理模型有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of brittle fracture simulations, enabling Monte Carlo studies of random field energy release rates.
summary_en.method: A weighted-variational model is proposed as a surrogate for the hybrid phase-field model, incorporating a Gaussian random field with Matérn covariance to model heterogeneous energy release rate.
summary_en.result: The surrogate model reduces execution time by 90% and accurately predicts fracture patterns and load-displacement curves in Monte Carlo analyses.
summary_en.validation: The surrogate is validated by comparing its predictions with an actual brittle fracture laboratory experiment.

title: Accelerating uncertainty quantification of groundwater flow modelling using a deep neural network proxy
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
first_author_affiliation: College of Engineering, Mathematics and Physical Sciences, University of Exeter, UK

corresponding_authors.name: Mikkel B. Lykkegaard
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Engineering, Mathematics and Physical Sciences, University of Exeter, UK

relevance_to_user: 该论文将深度神经网络代理模型与MCMC结合加速地下水流动模型的不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling for biomedical implant design, lacks constraint handling, and does not consider multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速地下水流动模型的不确定性量化，降低MCMC计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 设计延迟接受MCMC框架，利用DNN代理模型生成提案，并用自适应误差模型修正偏差。
summary_zh.result: 不确定性量化成本降低高达50%。
summary_zh.validation: 在二维和三维合成地下水模型上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate uncertainty quantification in groundwater flow modeling by reducing the computational cost of MCMC sampling.
summary_en.method: A delayed acceptance MCMC framework is proposed, using a deep neural network proxy to generate proposals and an adaptive error model to correct bias on-the-fly.
summary_en.result: The cost of uncertainty quantification is reduced by up to 50% compared to single-level MCMC.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two synthetic groundwater flow problems: a 2D isotropic and a 3D anisotropic case.

title: A non-intrusive reduced-order modelling for uncertainty propagation of time-dependent problems using a B-splines Bézier elements-based method and Proper Orthogonal Decomposition: application to dam-break flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的非侵入式降阶模型（POD-BSBEM）具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移到植入物力学仿真中的高效代理建模，但当前应用场景为水坝溃决流体动力学而非植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or constrained optimization; it focuses on fluid dynamics (dam-break) and lacks validation in biomechanical or implant contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效传播时间依赖问题中的不确定性并大幅加速计算。
summary_zh.method: 结合POD与B样条贝塞尔单元的混合降阶方法。
summary_zh.result: 在精度接近全阶模型的同时，离线与在线阶段均显著提速。
summary_zh.validation: 通过稳态/瞬态基准算例及溃坝流动案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient uncertainty propagation for time-dependent problems while substantially reducing computational cost.
summary_en.method: A hybrid reduced-order model combining proper orthogonal decomposition with B-splines Bézier elements to separate time and stochastic parameters.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves accurate statistical moments with significant speed-ups in both offline and online stages compared to POD-ANN and full-order PCE.
summary_en.validation: Validated on steady-state and time-dependent benchmarks and a realistic dam-break flow problem with complex bathymetry.

title: Partitioned Active Learning for Heterogeneous Systems
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的分区主动学习方法可以显著提高异构系统的代理建模效率，直接支持用户对昂贵仿真采样优化的需求。
why_not_core: No explicit handling of constraints, no UQ as primary focus, and not applied to biomechanics or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升异构系统主动学习的效率与准确性
summary_zh.method: 提出分区主动学习，结合全局搜索与局部搜索及Cholesky更新
summary_zh.result: 在数值模拟和实际案例中预测精度和计算效率优于基准方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟及航空航天、材料科学两个实例验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of active learning for surrogate modeling of heterogeneous systems that are expensive to evaluate.
summary_en.method: Proposes partitioned active learning with global and local search strategies, coupled with Cholesky updates for computational efficiency.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms benchmark approaches in prediction accuracy and computational cost on numerical simulations and two real-world case studies.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical simulations and two real-world engineering case studies: fuselage shape control and tribocorrosion-resistant alloy design.

title: Osseointegration Improvement of Co-Cr-Mo Alloy Produced by Additive Manufacturing.
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Medicine of Jundiaí, Jundiaí 13202-550, São Paulo, Brazil.

corresponding_authors.name: Marcelo Rodrigues da Cunha
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Medicine of Jundiaí, Jundiaí 13202-550, São Paulo, Brazil.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了增材制造Co-Cr-Mo合金的表面改性对骨整合的影响，与用户的方向有直接关系，但缺少力学性能验证和应力屏蔽分析。
why_not_core: The paper does not quantify stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it include mechanical testing (fatigue or static) of the porous structure, limiting its direct applicability to implant biomechanics optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高增材制造Co-Cr-Mo合金植入物的骨整合性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用等离子体浸没离子注入和钛涂层对3D打印Co-Cr-Mo合金进行表面改性。
summary_zh.result: 钛涂层结合离子注入显著促进了骨长入和骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 通过动物植入实验验证骨整合效果。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the osseointegration of additively manufactured Co-Cr-Mo alloy implants through surface modification.
summary_en.method: Plasma immersion ion implantation (PIII) and titanium coating were applied to laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) fabricated Co-Cr-Mo alloy samples with solid and porous regions.
summary_en.result: The titanium-coated and PIII-treated samples showed the highest bone ingrowth and biomechanical performance, with nearly all pores filled with bone.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal implantation was performed to evaluate osseointegration and bone formation.

key_terms.zh: 等离子体浸没离子注入

title: Interval Deep Learning for Uncertainty Quantification in Safety Applications
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的区间深度神经网络可用于不确定性量化，在生物力学代理模型中具有潜在应用，但未涉及有限元代理或设计优化。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, no sampling efficiency improvement, and no biomechanics or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 安全关键应用需量化输入不确定性，现有DNN方法在端到端训练时较少处理认知不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 提出Deep Interval Neural Network (DINN)，通过区间分析实现输入和参数不确定性的量化。
summary_zh.result: 在空气污染数据集上，DINN能从不确定输入生成准确的有界预测。
summary_zh.validation: 利用带传感器不确定性的空气污染数据集进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Safety-critical applications require uncertainty quantification in predictions, yet current DNNs lack mechanisms to propagate input epistemic uncertainty end-to-end.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Deep Interval Neural Network (DINN) that uses gradient-based optimization with interval analysis to quantify both input and parameter uncertainty.
summary_en.result: On an air pollution dataset with sensor uncertainty, DINN produces accurate bounded estimates from uncertain inputs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a real-world air pollution dataset with known sensor uncertainty.

title: Co-kriging based multi-fidelity uncertainty quantification of beam vibration using coarse and fine finite element meshes
venue: International Journal for Computational Methods in Engineering Science and Mechanics
first_author_affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, India

corresponding_authors.name: Ranjan Ganguli
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, India

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了多保真协同克里金方法在有限元模型不确定性量化中的应用，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高保真有限元模型的计算成本，同时保持精度。
summary_zh.method: 使用粗网格和细网格有限元模型构建多保真协同克里金代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型精度在1%以内，计算节省98%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过梁振动问题的蒙特卡洛不确定性量化验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of high-fidelity finite element models while maintaining accuracy in uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity co-kriging surrogate model is constructed using data from coarse and fine mesh finite element models.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves accuracy within 1% of the high-fidelity model while providing 98% computational savings.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification on a beam vibration problem.

title: Surface Roughness of Titanium Orthopedic Implants Alters the Biological Phenotype of Human Mesenchymal Stromal Cells
first_author_affiliation: Department of Biological Sciences, Hampton University, Hampton, Virginia, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Matthew P. Abdel
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, USA

corresponding_authors.name: David G. Lewallen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, USA

corresponding_authors.name: André J. van Wijnen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了钛植入体表面粗糙度对间充质干细胞生物学表型的影响，与用户关注的LPBF制造、应力遮挡和疲劳性能无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on in vitro cellular response to surface roughness, not on LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue, or stress shielding of porous implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究钛植入体表面粗糙度对细胞行为的影响，以改善植入体长期固定。
summary_zh.method: 在不同粗糙度钛盘上培养间充质干细胞，进行RNA测序和基因表达分析。
summary_zh.result: 高粗糙度表面促进早期细胞外基质生成，并引发氧化应激和重金属应激反应。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验结合基因表达分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how surface roughness of titanium orthopedic implants affects cellular behavior at the host-implant interface, aiming to improve long-term implant fixation.
summary_en.method: Mesenchymal stromal cells were cultured on clinical-grade Ti6Al4V disks with varying surface roughness (high, medium, low), and differential mRNA expression was analyzed via RNA-seq and qPCR.
summary_en.result: High surface roughness promoted early extracellular matrix production and induced oxidative and heavy metal stress responses in cells.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments with gene expression analysis.

title: SPUX Framework: a Scalable Package for Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification and Propagation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一个通用的贝叶斯不确定性量化框架，可迁移到FEA代理模型的UQ中，但未直接涉及生物力学或植入物设计问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modelling for FEA, does not handle multi-objective constraints, and lacks validation on biomechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提供可扩展的贝叶斯不确定性量化和传播框架
summary_zh.method: 构建模块化框架，支持多种算法和编程语言，可耦合任意应用
summary_zh.result: 在随机游走模型和环境科学案例中展示框架能力

first_author_affiliation: Nagoya Institute of Technology, Nagoya, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Shogo Iwazaki
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Nagoya Institute of Technology, Nagoya, Japan

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化框架考虑了均值-方差权衡，可迁移到植入物设计中的不确定性优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA or biomechanical design, nor does it validate on any engineering simulation case.

summary_zh.motivation: 在不确定环境下进行主动学习时需权衡多个风险指标。
summary_zh.method: 提出均值-方差贝叶斯优化框架，推导风险度量边界并设计主动学习算法。
summary_zh.result: 通过理论分析和数值实验验证了算法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上测试，无工程案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address active learning under uncertainty where trade-offs between multiple risk measures are required.
summary_en.method: Proposes a mean-variance Bayesian optimization framework that derives bounds for risk measures and designs active learning algorithms for multi-task, multi-objective, and constrained scenarios.
summary_en.result: Theoretical analysis and numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks without application to engineering simulations.

title: Latent Derivative Bayesian Last Layer Networks
first_author_affiliation: Technische Universität Darmstadt,

corresponding_authors.name: Joe Watson
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Technische Universität Darmstadt,

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯神经网络方法可用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate application, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络在分布外预测时过于自信，需要改进不确定性校准。
summary_zh.method: 在贝叶斯最后一层网络中引入输入导数的函数先验，作为潜在变量优化特征空间。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在分布外回归、贝叶斯优化和主动学习任务上达到类似高斯过程的性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归基准和真实世界高维数据集上验证不确定性校准效果。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian neural networks often produce overconfident predictions on out-of-distribution data, necessitating improved uncertainty calibration.
summary_en.method: A functional prior on the model's input derivatives is introduced as latent variables in a Bayesian last layer network to regularize feature smoothness and diversity.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves Gaussian process-level performance on OOD regression, Bayesian optimization, and active learning tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard regression benchmarks and high-dimensional real-world datasets, focusing on uncertainty calibration metrics.

title: Emerging metallic systems for additive manufacturing: In-situ alloying and multi-metal processing in laser powder bed fusion

why_not_core: This paper is a review of in-situ alloying and multi-metal processing in LPBF, but does not cover porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or osseointegration.

summary_zh.method: 系统回顾了材料设计、工艺参数和微观结构控制策略
summary_zh.result: 总结了不同合金体系和多金属界面的研究现状与挑战
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述

summary_en.motivation: This review summarizes the state-of-the-art in in-situ alloying and multi-metal processing during laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: The paper systematically categorizes material design strategies, process parameter effects, and microstructural control approaches.
summary_en.result: Key findings highlight the potential and current limitations of producing compositionally graded and multi-material components.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided; the paper is a literature review.

title: Effect of porosity of a functionally-graded scaffold for the treatment of corticosteroid-associated osteonecrosis of the femoral head in rabbits

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Bioengineering, Stanford University School of Medicine, Stanford, CA, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔支架孔隙率对骨坏死治疗的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳性能或LPBF制造，与用户研究方向关联度较低。
why_not_core: This paper uses 3D printing (not LPBF) with PCL/β-TCP, does not address stress shielding or stiffness matching for hip implants, lacks fatigue testing, and focuses on rabbit femoral head osteonecrosis rather than human hip implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索不同孔隙率的功能梯度支架对股骨头坏死骨再生的影响
summary_zh.method: 3D打印PCL/β-TCP支架，植入兔股骨头坏死模型，8周后评估
summary_zh.result: 30%孔隙率支架骨长入率和刚度显著高于60%孔隙率组
summary_zh.validation: 兔体内动物实验，结合microCT、力学推出测试和组织学分析

summary_en.motivation: To determine the optimal porosity of a functionally-graded scaffold for enhancing bone regeneration and mechanical support in corticosteroid-associated osteonecrosis of the femoral head.
summary_en.method: 3D-printed polycaprolactone/β-tricalcium phosphate scaffolds with 30% or 60% porosity were implanted into rabbit femoral heads after core decompression, and evaluated after 8 weeks.
summary_en.result: The 30% porosity scaffold achieved significantly higher bone ingrowth ratio (73.9%) and stiffness (582.4 N/mm³) compared to the 60% porosity scaffold.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rabbit model with microCT, push-out mechanical testing, and histological analysis.

title: Decision Theoretic Bootstrapping
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种决策理论引导的bootstrap方法用于不确定性量化，可迁移至代理模型中的UQ问题，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决有限数据下训练与测试分布不确定性的鲁棒UQ问题
summary_zh.method: 将数据分为训练和UQ子集，通过对抗博弈得到最优混合模型和UQ估计
summary_zh.result: 提供对分布偏移的鲁棒性及输出空间的条件概率分布
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To achieve robust uncertainty quantification under finite data and potential distributional shift between training and testing distributions.
summary_en.method: Partitions data into training and UQ subsets, trains multiple models on subsamples, and solves a two-player adversarial game to obtain optimal mixed strategies for model selection and UQ distribution.
summary_en.result: The approach provides robustness to distributional shift and yields conditional probability distributions on the output space as aleatory uncertainty representations.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical exposition without experimental or numerical validation.

visual.caption: Figure 1. Train-UQ Partitioning of the Data . The left plot shows the schematic partitioning of the original empirical data into two exclusive train and UQ sets. The middle plot shows how the train set is used to train m m ML estimators (randomly). Here, the training sets are found by subsampling the train dataset m m times. The right plot shows the procedure of breaking up the UQ set into n n subsets, from which n n different empirical distributions can be extracted.

title: Bayesian optimization of high entropy alloy properties
venue: Bulletin of the American Physical Society
relevance_to_user: 该论文将贝叶斯优化应用于高熵合金性能优化，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化问题。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速高熵合金性能优化，减少昂贵实验或模拟次数。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯优化框架，基于高斯过程代理模型迭代搜索最优成分。
summary_zh.result: 在有限评估次数内找到性能更优的合金成分。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证优化效率。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the discovery of high entropy alloys with optimal properties by reducing the number of expensive experiments or simulations.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework with Gaussian process surrogate models is employed to iteratively search the composition space.
summary_en.result: The method identifies superior alloy compositions within a limited number of evaluations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark problems to demonstrate optimization efficiency.

title: Efficient Bayesian Optimization using Multiscale Graph Correlation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于多尺度图相关的贝叶斯优化方法，可提高昂贵黑箱函数的优化效率，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或生物力学设计应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition function, or any application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高昂贵黑箱函数的贝叶斯优化效率
summary_zh.method: 提出GP-MGC方法，最大化多尺度图相关以选择下一个查询点
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实数据集上表现优于或等同于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准函数和真实数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of Bayesian optimization for expensive black-box functions.
summary_en.method: Proposes GP-MGC, which selects the next query point by maximizing multiscale graph correlation with respect to the global maximum.
summary_en.result: GP-MGC performs as well as or better than state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmark functions and real-world datasets.

title: Data-driven nonintrusive reduced order modeling for dynamical systems with moving boundaries using Gaussian process regression
relevance_to_user: 该方法适用于具有移动边界的动力系统降阶建模，可迁移至生物力学中植入物-骨界面或生物打印中喷嘴移动等场景。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on moving boundary dynamical systems (e.g., fluid-structure interaction) without any implant mechanics, biomechanics context, or FEA surrogate validation for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有移动边界降阶方法侵入性强，需开发非侵入式方法。
summary_zh.method: 结合POD、高斯过程回归和移动最小二乘插值构建非侵入式降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明该方法能准确预测未来时刻的全阶解，并给出误差分析和最大预测时间准则。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个基准问题的解析/数值解和实验测量数据验证精度和效率。

summary_en.motivation: Existing model order reduction methods for dynamical systems with moving boundaries are often intrusive, motivating a nonintrusive data-driven approach.
summary_en.method: The proposed method combines proper orthogonal decomposition, Gaussian process regression, and moving least squares interpolation to construct a reduced order model from snapshot data without knowledge of the full-order model or governing equations.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate forecasting of full-order solutions beyond the snapshot time range, with error analysis and criteria for determining the maximum forecast horizon.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on benchmark problems using analytical, numerical, and experimental measurement data.

title: dNNsolve: an efficient NN-based PDE solver
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种改进的PINN求解器，可提高PDE求解效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to implant biomechanics, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no validation on engineering design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN实现需要精细调参且精度不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出双神经网络架构，结合正弦和Sigmoid激活函数。
summary_zh.result: 在1-3维时空的多种ODE/PDE上无需调参即可求解。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证精度。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINN implementations require extensive hyperparameter tuning and lack accuracy for a broad class of PDEs.
summary_en.method: Introduces a dual neural network architecture with sine and sigmoidal activation functions to capture both secular and periodic patterns.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates accurate solution of various ODEs/PDEs in 1-3 spacetime dimensions without hyperparameter fine-tuning.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems including 1D, 2D, and 3D PDEs.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : dNNsolve network architecture for the case D = 3 D=3 : multiple input variables are processed independently using Dense layers with sine and sigmoid activation functions. The results are then processed by three multiplication layers and finally merged together using a concatenation layer. The final output (scalar in this picture) is then computed using a simple dense layer with no activation function.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a biodegradable composite scaffold that neutralizes acidic degradation products for bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Fused deposition modeling was used to fabricate gyroid porous scaffolds from PLA composites with MgO and phosphate glass fiber.
summary_en.result: MgO effectively buffered the acidic environment, and the composite scaffolds exhibited compressive properties comparable to human trabecular bone.
summary_en.validation: Compression testing and in vitro degradation experiments were conducted to evaluate mechanical properties and pH regulation.

title: A review on the recent advances concerning the fatigue performance of titanium alloys for orthopedic applications

relevance_to_user: 该综述讨论了钛合金疲劳性能与表面改性、增材制造缺陷的关系，但未涉及多孔结构设计或应力遮挡匹配。
why_not_core: This is a review paper that does not present new experimental data on LPBF-fabricated porous structures, nor does it link fatigue to stress shielding or stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述钛合金疲劳性能对骨科植入物可靠性的影响
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾Ti-6Al-4V、增材制造及亚稳β钛合金的疲劳研究
summary_zh.result: 表面改性和增材制造缺陷显著影响疲劳性能，亚稳β合金数据匮乏
summary_zh.validation: 文献综述，无新实验验证

summary_en.motivation: This review summarizes recent advances in fatigue behavior of titanium alloys for orthopedic applications, emphasizing the impact of surface modifications and additive manufacturing defects.
summary_en.method: A systematic literature review covering Ti-6Al-4V, additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, and metastable β titanium alloys.
summary_en.result: Surface treatments and inherent defects from additive manufacturing severely affect fatigue performance, while data on metastable β alloys remain scarce.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a review paper.

title: Non-intrusive Surrogate Modeling for Parametrized Time-dependent PDEs using Convolutional Autoencoders
relevance_to_user: 该方法利用卷积自编码器构建参数化时变PDE的替代模型，可推广至植入物生物力学仿真中的昂贵采样问题。
why_not_core: Does not handle constraints, lacks explicit uncertainty quantification beyond Monte Carlo, and has no demonstration on biomechanics or implant problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速参数化时变偏微分方程的重复求解。
summary_zh.method: 使用卷积自编码器压缩高维解，再用前馈神经网络映射参数空间到潜在空间。
summary_zh.result: 替代模型能准确预测新参数下的解，显著降低计算成本。
summary_zh.validation: 在随机偏微分方程的蒙特卡洛分析中验证准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate repeated solution of parametrized time-dependent PDEs by building a low-cost surrogate that bypasses high-fidelity simulation.
summary_en.method: A convolutional autoencoder compresses high-dimensional spatiotemporal solution matrices, and a feedforward neural network learns the mapping from parameter space to the latent representation.
summary_en.result: The surrogate accurately predicts full solutions at new parameter points with substantial cost reduction.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on stochastic analysis of time-dependent PDEs using Monte Carlo method with finite element reference solutions.

key_terms.zh: 参数化时变偏微分方程

title: Controlling and testing anisotropy in additively manufactured stochastic structures
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Imperial College London, South Kensington, London SW7 2AZ, United Kingdom

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF制造的各向同性随机多孔结构，并进行了多方向力学测试，与用户关注的植入物应力屏蔽和刚度匹配方向相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or implant stiffness matching, does not report fatigue testing, and does not evaluate surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服LPBF制造中周期性多孔结构的各向异性问题
summary_zh.method: 设计并LPBF制造随机多孔结构，在10个方向进行压缩测试
summary_zh.result: 改进后的结构弹性模量标准差显著降低，实现了各向同性
summary_zh.validation: 通过多方向压缩实验验证各向同性

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the inherent anisotropy of periodic lattice structures fabricated by LPBF, which limits multi-axial applications.
summary_en.method: Stochastic porous structures were designed and fabricated via LPBF in SS316L and Ti6Al4V, then tested in uniaxial compression along 10 orientations.
summary_en.result: Modified stochastic structures exhibited reduced standard deviation of elastic modulus, achieving improved isotropy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests in multiple orientations validated the isotropy of the structures.

title: An Approach to Bayesian Optimization for Design Feasibility Check on Discontinuous Black-Box Functions
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Oregon State University, Corvallis, OR 97331

corresponding_authors.name: Arpan Biswas
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Oregon State University, Corvallis, OR 97331

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化方法用于处理不连续黑箱函数的可行性检查，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束边界预测。
why_not_core: The paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive FEA simulations, lacks uncertainty quantification beyond classification, and is not applied to biomechanics or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯优化在不连续设计空间中的可行性检查问题
summary_zh.method: 通过人工投影连续空间预测不连续边界，最大化采样至过渡区域
summary_zh.result: 分类误差率<1%，函数评估约150次，优于SVM、随机森林等
summary_zh.validation: 薄管设计案例验证，与现有ML算法对比

summary_en.motivation: To enable Bayesian optimization to handle discontinuous black-box functions for design feasibility checks.
summary_en.method: Project the original discontinuous space onto a continuous one and train the BO to maximize sampling near the unknown transition region.
summary_en.result: Achieves classification error below 1% with about 150 function evaluations, outperforming SVM, Random Forest, and Boosting.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a thin tube design problem with creep-fatigue failure constraint.

title: A Novel Physics-Based and Data-Supported Microstructure Model for\n Part-Scale Simulation of Laser Powder Bed Fusion of Ti-6Al-4V
first_author_affiliation: Technische Universität München (Arcisstraße 21, 80333, Munich, Germany - Germany)

corresponding_authors.name: Jonas Nitzler
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Technische Universität München (Arcisstraße 21, 80333, Munich, Germany - Germany)

relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于LPBF过程中Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构演化建模，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户研究方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structure design, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or surface roughness/osseointegration, which are core to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立适用于LPBF零件尺度模拟的Ti-6Al-4V微观结构演化模型
summary_zh.method: 提出基于物理和数据支持的唯象模型，通过扩散和非扩散相变预测相分数
summary_zh.result: 模型能自然重现临界冷却速率等实验特征，无需启发式判据
summary_zh.validation: 利用连续冷却转变图验证模型预测能力

summary_en.motivation: To develop a microstructure evolution model for Ti-6Al-4V suitable for part-scale simulation of selective laser melting processes.
summary_en.method: A physics-based and data-supported phenomenological model is proposed, predicting phase fractions of beta, alpha_s, and martensite via diffusion-based and non-diffusional transformations without heuristic criteria.
summary_en.result: The model naturally reproduces experimentally observed characteristics such as critical cooling rates in continuous cooling transformation diagrams.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using continuous cooling transformation diagrams, demonstrating predictive ability against experimental data.

title: Uncertainty quantification for data-driven turbulence modelling with Mondrian forests
first_author_affiliation: Data-Centric Engineering, The Alan Turing Institute, London, UK

corresponding_authors.name: Ashley Scillitoe
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Data-Centric Engineering, The Alan Turing Institute, London, UK

relevance_to_user: 该论文将Mondrian森林用于湍流建模的不确定性量化，方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的UQ问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on turbulence modeling in fluid dynamics, not on solid mechanics FEA, implant design, or biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统湍流模型存在不确定性，需要数据驱动方法进行量化。
summary_zh.method: 采用Mondrian森林作为概率模型，对RANS模型中的雷诺应力进行不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: Mondrian森林能有效提供预测不确定性，且计算效率高。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个湍流基准案例上验证，与DNS数据对比。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional turbulence models suffer from inherent uncertainties, motivating data-driven approaches for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Mondrian forests are employed as probabilistic models to quantify uncertainties in Reynolds stresses within RANS simulations.
summary_en.result: Mondrian forests effectively provide predictive uncertainties with high computational efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on several turbulent flow benchmark cases against DNS data.

title: CobBO: Coordinate Backoff Bayesian Optimization with Two-Stage Kernels
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的高维贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移到生物力学设计的代理模型优化中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design, focusing instead on general high-dimensional optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高维贝叶斯优化的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 采用两阶段核函数与坐标回退策略，先粗后精逼近函数
summary_zh.result: 在数十至数百维上取得与先进方法相当或更优解，且降低复杂度
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of Bayesian optimization in high-dimensional spaces.
summary_en.method: A two-stage kernel approach with coordinate backoff is proposed, using a coarse kernel first for global landscape capture and a fine kernel in selected subspaces with virtual points.
summary_en.result: The method achieves comparable or better optimization performance than state-of-the-art methods across dimensions ranging from tens to hundreds, while significantly reducing trial complexity and computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical benchmark evaluations on synthetic and real-world high-dimensional functions.

title: A general framework of rotational sparse approximation in uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法可用于提高UQ中的gPC系数估计效率，适用于植入物设计的不确定性量化，但目前未应用于生物力学或FEA场景。
why_not_core: paper does not demonstrate application to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics; lacks contact mechanics, patient-specific geometry, or experimental validation in biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少不确定性量化中计算开销，提高gPC系数估计稀疏性
summary_zh.method: 提出旋转稀疏近似框架，结合非凸正则化与ADMM求解
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明性能优于无旋转或l1正则化方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of uncertainty quantification by estimating sparse gPC coefficients via a rotational approach.
summary_en.method: Propose a framework that identifies an optimal rotation matrix to enhance sparsity and uses nonconvex regularizations solved by ADMM.
summary_en.result: Numerical examples demonstrate superior performance over standard l1 regularization with or without rotation.
summary_en.validation: Tested on numerical benchmark problems.

title: Solving Allen-Cahn and Cahn-Hilliard Equations Using the Adaptive Physics Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN求解相场方程精度不足，需改进。
summary_zh.method: 提出时空自适应采样策略增强PINN逼近能力。
summary_zh.result: 改进的PINN在Allen-Cahn和Cahn-Hilliard方程上精度和效率提升。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs fail to accurately solve phase-field equations, motivating adaptive improvements.
summary_en.method: An adaptive physics-informed neural network with spatial and temporal sampling strategies is proposed.
summary_en.result: The improved PINN achieves higher accuracy and efficiency on Allen-Cahn and Cahn-Hilliard equations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard phase-field problems.

title: Short stem total hip arthroplasty with the direct anterior approach demonstrates suboptimal fixation

summary_en.motivation: To report the complication rate and mid-term clinical and radiological outcomes of a short stem implanted via the direct anterior approach.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study of 698 elective THAs with a mean follow-up of 6.2 years, evaluating clinical scores and radiographic signs of fixation.
summary_en.result: At five years, 31.5% of hips had proximal radiolucencies, 12.9% showed stem subsidence ≥2 mm, and 4.2% underwent revision.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up and radiographic assessment.

title: Scaling Up Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification for Inverse Problems using Deep Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过深度神经网络替代模型和自编码器降维，可推广到生物力学设计中高效的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant validation, no biomechanics context, no FEA surrogate for structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维反问题中贝叶斯不确定性量化计算成本过高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于深度神经网络的校准-仿真-采样框架并融合自编码器降维
summary_zh.result: 将贝叶斯推理速度提升三个数量级且对训练集变化鲁棒
summary_zh.validation: 在低维解析例和高维椭圆/对流扩散PDE例上验证精度与效率

summary_en.motivation: To enable scalable Bayesian uncertainty quantification for high-dimensional inverse problems that traditional MCMC methods cannot handle efficiently.
summary_en.method: A Dimension-Reduced Emulative Autoencoder Monte Carlo (DREAMC) algorithm that uses deep neural network emulation and autoencoder-based dimension reduction.
summary_en.result: The method achieves up to three orders of magnitude speedup over conventional approaches while maintaining accuracy and robustness.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on two low-dimensional (linear and nonlinear) and two high-dimensional (elliptic and advection-diffusion) numerical inverse problems.

title: Hull shape design optimization with parameter space and model reductions, and self-learning mesh morphing
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过POD和主动子空间降维及代理模型加速形状优化，虽应用于船舶但技术可迁移至生物医学植入物设计。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant design problems; no explicit constraint handling or uncertainty quantification focus.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低参数化形状优化中高保真求解的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 结合POD、主动子空间遗传算法和RBF网格变形，构建数据驱动代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 在船舶基准例上验证了框架的有效性和效率提升。
summary_zh.validation: 基于船舶外形优化的数值仿真案例。

summary_en.motivation: Reduce the computational burden of parametric shape optimization by combining multiple model and parameter space reduction techniques.
summary_en.method: Propose a data-driven framework integrating proper orthogonal decomposition, active subspace genetic algorithm, and radial basis function mesh morphing for efficient shape optimization.
summary_en.result: Demonstrate the framework's accuracy and speedup on a benchmark ship hull design problem.
summary_en.validation: Validated through a numerical benchmark case of ship hull shape optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估TiNbTa合金作为骨替代材料的力学与生物功能。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同孔隙率的TiNbTa泡沫，测试力学性能并开展细胞实验。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate TiNbTa alloy as a prosthetic biomaterial for bone replacement focusing on rigidity and biocompatibility.
summary_en.method: TiNbTa foams with varying porosity were fabricated and tested for mechanical properties and in vitro osteoblast response.
summary_en.result: TiNbTa foams with 20-30% porosity match cortical bone rigidity and promote cell adhesion, while 80% porosity suits trabecular bone replacement.
summary_en.validation: Validation included mechanical compression testing and in vitro cell adhesion/proliferation assays.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify important factors in expensive simulation systems.

summary_en.motivation: To achieve controlled formation of bi-lamellar microstructures in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V via targeted heat treatment.

summary_zh.result: 成功校准反四手性拉胀结构模型，讨论了精度与扩展性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验DIC数据与仿真对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate simulation of SLM-manufactured metamaterials is challenging due to geometric deviations and process-induced defects, necessitating a calibration approach using experimental data.
summary_en.method: A phenomenological simulation model is calibrated by combining nodal displacements from global DIC with experimental forces using LS-OPT, exploiting lattice symmetries.
summary_en.result: The calibrated model accurately reproduces the deformation of an antitetrachiral auxetic structure, with discussion on accuracy and applicability to other structures.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing simulation results with experimental DIC displacement fields.
